decision.summary: No new action: the board is clean again, but the bullish extension case is no longer confirmed enough to justify a fresh daily reach.
decision.rationale: Beecthor still allows more upside in principle, but his latest map specifically treated a break above roughly 79.48k as the cleaner confirmation for a larger extension. At this snapshot BTC is still below that confirmation area, Binance has cooled to neutral over the last 12 hours, and open interest is no longer expanding. The nearest bullish daily candidate, 79k reach, has also repriced down to about 24.5%, which weakens the reward-to-certainty profile compared with the earlier breakout window. Bearish dailies and weeklys remain even less compelling. With no open positions and no strong confirmation in either direction, the disciplined decision is NO_ACTION.
